Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 17

“With understanding fixed on that, self absorbed in that, established in that, devoted to that, they go where there is no returning, their faults shaken off by knowledge.”

Four phrases saying nearly the same thing in a row. The insistent repetition of tat, that, does the work — a mind gone entirely in one direction.
